newsitem.title: USA: Biospherics files suit against Forbes mag.
newsitem.headline: Biospherics files suit against Forbes mag.

text.p: Biospherics Inc on Monday said it has filed a libel suit against Forbes Magazine alleging defamation of the company and one of its products and seeking $15 million in damages.

The company alleges that the disputed information regarding its non-fattening sugar product, D-tagatose, was released to the financial community just prior to the company's announcement on January 6 of a key licensing agreement.
The company claims that the Forbes article is responsible for a decline in Biospherics' stock price, and has interfered with their ability to raise additional capital.
A spokesman from Forbes was not immediately available to comment on the suit.
